disclaimer_title: ⚠️ Collaborative and independent pilot — non-commercial site.
disclaimer_text: Information and coordinates come from public sources and sailors’ reports: they are indicative, may be inaccurate, outdated or wrong and do not replace official charts, official guides or direct on-site verification. Anchorages, accesses, regulations and sea conditions must always be checked by the Skipper before and during navigation. Every decision and responsibility lies solely with the Skipper. The authors assume no liability for damages, losses, penalties or incidents arising from the use of this content.
wiki_free_extra1: This wiki was born from sailors for sailors. You can use it freely, without registering, without limits and without advertising. Registration is only if you wish, to receive alerts for safety critical issues and general weather or to contribute with verified on-site updates.
wiki_free_extra2: Without registration you read everything; with registration, if you wish, you stay updated and help others. The choice is yours. See __I18N_subscribe__ or __I18N_login__ — or start exploring.
